title: エネルギーデバイス工学
subtitle: Energy Devices Engineering
teachers:
KONO Akihiko
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Harmonization with the environment is required to utilize modern electric energy. In this course, students learn the social background of environmental energy. Next, primary batteries, secondary batteries, fuel cells, solar cells, piezoelectric / thermoelectric conversion elements, etc. are taught as important energy conversion devices constituting an electric energy system. The development trend, the situation of practical use, the structure, the operation principle, and the characteristics are learned.
advice:
The following topics will be addressed in this lecture.

1. Environmental energy problems and energy conversion applied devices
 Current status of environmental energy problems / Overview of various energy conversion application devices
2. Fundamentals of electrochemical energy conversion
 Electrolysis and battery / principle of voltage generation / principle of current generation
3. Operation principle of electrochemical device
 Primary battery / Secondary battery / Fuel cell / Electric double layer capacitor
4. Fundamentals of photoelectric conversion, thermoelectric conversion, and piezoelectric conversion
 Principle of photovoltaic generation / Principle of thermoelectric generation / Principle of piezoelectric effect
5. Operating principle of photoelectric conversion, thermoelectric conversion, and piezoelectric conversion device
 Solar cell / Thermoelectric device / Piezoelectric device
6. Other power storage technologies
requiredKnowledge: This subject covers a wide range of energy conversion & storage technologies resulting from environmental energy problems. Therefore, in addition to knowledge in the fields of chemistry and physics, it is an integrated subject that requires a social perspective on the environment. Work to deepen understanding while referring to textbooks in each field as appropriate.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain global environmental energy issues and the role of various energy conversion devices.
Be able to explain an overview of electrochemical energy conversion, which is the basis of batteries
Be able to explain the characteristics of various devices to which electrochemical energy conversion is applied.
Be able to explain the principle of photoelectric, thermoelectric, and piezoelectric conversion and its applicat
Be able to explain the type, operation principle and development status about the power storage technologies.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1 Explain in detail the global energy policy and technology development trends regarding environmental energy.
2 Explain the principle of electrochemical energy conversion theoretically.
3 Explain the principles and features of primary cells, secondary cells, fuel cells and EDLC.
4 Explain the operating principle and characteristics of photoelectric conversion, thermoelectric conversion, and piezoelectric conversion device in detail in relation to the constituent materials.
5 Explain the principles and characteristics of various power storage technologies in detail.
achievementLevels.standard:
1 Explain Japan's environmental energy policy and technology development trends.
2 Explain the principle of electrochemical energy conversion.
3 Explain the principles and features of electrochemical devices such as primary batteries, secondary batteries, fuel cells, and electric double layer capacitors.
4 Explain the operating principle of photoelectric conversion, thermoelectric conversion, and piezoelectric conversion device.
5 Give an overview of various power storage technologies.
